first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: The nearest person facing away from the camera, wearing a gray broad-brimmed steel helmet, with an orange-brown covering flap, buckled shoulder straps, and a light-colored backpack on the upper back, and carrying a long gun on the back.

entities.name: Person B
entities.identification: The companion ahead of Person A, wearing a gray steel helmet and a yellowish-brown high-collared outer garment, and carrying a canvas bag and a long gun on the back.

entities.name: trench wall
entities.identification: The reinforced walls on both sides of the passageway, composed of earthen walls, boards, posts, and sections of corrugated panels, excluding the ground and the sandbags atop the walls.

entities.name: group of other soldiers in the trench
entities.identification: The group of background soldiers other than Person A, Person B, and Person D, including the person bending forward in front of the entrance, the low-positioned person on the right, and the standing people in the distance.

entities.name: wood-framed bunker with a dark opening
entities.identification: The dark entrance beside the wall on the right at the beginning of the clip, enclosed by rough wooden beams.

entities.name: muddy passageway ground
entities.identification: The gray-brown, uneven muddy ground between the trench walls.

entities.name: Person D
entities.identification: The person who passes toward the camera on the image-left side of Person A, wearing a gray steel helmet, with light brown cape-like fabric wrapped around the neck, shoulders, and upper body.

entities.name: brown sandbags atop the wall
entities.identification: The brown elongated bags stacked horizontally in layers along the tops of both walls.

entities.name: exposed mound of earth atop the wall
entities.identification: The brown exposed earth rising above the wall tops behind the sandbags, with an irregular, undulating outline.

entities.name: grayish-white sky
entities.identification: The low-saturation grayish-white sky area above the wall tops and mounds of earth.

entities.name: trench cable
entities.identification: The thin lines sagging above the entrance and the overhead lines near the distant utility poles, recorded in groups by area.

entities.name: utility pole
entities.identification: The slender vertical poles protruding above the distant wall tops, some with crossarms and short vertical components at their tops.

entities.name: soldier's long gun
entities.identification: The two slender guns protruding upward behind the shoulders and backs of Person A and Person B, with brown sections and dark metal sections.

entities.name: distant handheld object
entities.identification: The visible portion of an implement in front of the hands of the more image-left of the two distant standing people, with a broad dark end; the scope includes only this visible broad end.
